seo_title: UK Payments Forward Plan 2026: Stablecoins da Open Banking
excerpt: UK Payments Forward Plan da fakitin manufofin Afrilu 2026 sun shimfiɗa tsari ɗaya ga biyan kuɗi na al'ada, stablecoins, adibassu da aka mai da su tokens, open banking, da biyan kuɗi ta wakili. Tambayar dabarun ga bankuna ita ce horon zane: wace data, hanyoyi, sarrafawa, alhakai, da hanyoyin aikin abokin ciniki suka dace tare — kuma yadda za a tabbatar wa masu tsari.
subtitle: UK na matsar da tsarin biyan kuɗi zuwa tsari ɗaya mai daidaito wanda ya haɗa biyan kuɗi na banki, e-money, stablecoins, adibassu da aka mai da su tokens, open banking, da wakilan AI.
